author: Terry Roberts
description: Pilots, politicians, hotel workers, bus drivers and church leaders who had a front row seat to the aftermath of the Sept, 11, 2001, terrorist attacks gathered at the Gander airport on Thursday to reflect on a life-changing experience.
title: 'Nothing happens here. You're safe': 9/11 survivors, responders recall attack aftermath

author: Marissa Birnie
description: A disturbing incident in which someone dressed in a Cat in the Hat costume chased a teenager in West Kelowna, B.C., occurred amid an online trend that twists the popular children's character into something sinister, leading police in some jurisdictions to warn of offline consequences.
title: Cat in the Hat suspect who chased a teen girl in B.C. appears to be a trend copycat

description: In an emailed statement Thursday, Ontario Public Service Employees Union (OPSEU) Local 549 told CBC News that 27 permanent roles and four contract roles at the centre were impacted.
title: 31 workers laid off at Ontario Science Centre, union says

author: Kevin Maimann
description: An over-the-counter pain reliever is being recalled due to the possible presence of "foreign material" that could harm the digestive system.
title: Generic acetaminophen pills recalled due to possible 'foreign material' contamination

description: See highlights from the Toronto International Film Festival, featuring nearly 300 titles, 800 guests and thousands of industry delegates during the 11-day event starting on Thursday.
title: IN PHOTOS | TIFF movies and moments

author: Alina Snisarenko
description: The family of a teen struck by a driver at a Toronto intersection that used to have an automated speed enforcement (ASE) camera before Ontario passed legislation to remove it is suing the province, city and driver for millions of dollars in damages.
title: Family of teen struck at Toronto intersection where speed camera was removed sues province, city and driver

description: Canada's Army formally made one of the biggest changes to its structure in decades Thursday by shifting from divisions based on geography to ones built around specific purposes. A new division, that prepares the army to rapidly deploy, will be headquartered in Edmonton.
title: First phase of Army restructuring creates division focused on defending Canada

author: Jorge Barrera, Tania Miranda Perez
description: A U.K. man facing accusations he took part in a scheme that wiped out a Canadian couple's retirement savings says he's provided proof to Mexican authorities probing the case that he never touched a dime of the vanished funds, and that he's also a victim of his co-accused.
title: Man accused in Mexican condo scheme claims he was a victim, too

author: Abby Hughes, Jeff Lagerquist
description: CBC News has obtained the federal government's "prospectus" detailing investment opportunities ahead of next week's Canada Investment Summit in Toronto, which includes various plans across eight areas of investment.
title: From pipelines, to railways and AI: Ottawa pitches 167 projects ahead of Carney's investment summit

description: Harry Styles has announced an expansion of his Together, Together 2027 tour, which will see him come to Toronto for two dates at Rogers Stadium.
title: Harry Styles expands tour, will play Rogers Stadium in Toronto for two dates in 2027

author: Alexandra Mae Jones
description: Elon Musk is reportedly taking legal action against a documentary about him after its buzz-filled debut this week, slamming director Alex Gibney as a "horrible human" on social media.
title: Elon Musk calls documentary about him a 'hit piece' after buzzy debut

author: CBC News, The Canadian Press
description: The Edmonton Oilers decision to sign a hockey player who was acquitted last year of sexual assault has sparked a wave of disappointment and calls to "do better" among hockey fans and non-fans alike.
title: Edmonton Oilers facing online backlash after signing Alex Formenton

description: A Dutch tour bus overturned in a serious accident in eastern Switzerland, leaving several people dead and others injured, police said.
title: Several dead after tour bus overturns in Switzerland, police say

description: Lindsay Clancy's lawyer has asked the judge who oversaw the Massachusetts woman's murder trial to declare her not guilty by reason of insanity, saying ‌prosecutors had failed to prove that, despite being mentally ill, she knew killing her three young children would be wrong.
title: Lindsay Clancy's lawyer asks judge to find her not guilty of murder following mistrial

author: Liam Casey
description: Ontario Premier Doug Ford said he's open to the idea of involuntary addiction treatment. Ontario's Big City Mayors group recently repeated a request to the province to review existing mental health laws with the idea of expanding involuntary treatment.
title: Doug Ford says he's open to idea of involuntary addiction treatment

author: Sheena Goodyear
description: A new study shows pygmy raccoons in Mexico rummaging through bins for paper and other materials, crafting those scraps into balls to play with, and teaching her family members how to do the same.
title: These tiny endangered raccoons make their own toys out of trash

author: Creeson Agecoutay
description: The founder of Orange Shirt Day and MPs say orange shirts with statements printed "Still no proof," and "You can't handle the truth," are "disgusting" and a "disgraceful and grotesque attempt to exploit human suffering for financial gain."
title: Orange Shirt Day founder says her truth is being 'pushed aside' by controversial shirts

description: ABC late-night talk show host Jimmy Kimmel said an interview with Democratic Senate candidate James Talarico on Thursday will air on YouTube and not during the network broadcast, citing threats from the ‌Federal Communications Commission.
title: Kimmel says interview with Democratic candidate won't air on his network show, cites FCC threats

author: Murray Brewster
description: Canada and Ukraine signed a sweeping 100-year partnership on Thursday that puts defence production at its core. Ottawa plans to build millions of drones, pairing Canadian firms with Ukraine's battle-tested industry, while expanding co-operation on counter-drone technology, munitions and AI. Canada also pledged new funding for air defence and energy security.
title: Canada, Ukraine forge 100-year pact built on drones and defence

author: Lisa Johnson
description: Saddle Lake Cree Nation says its aiming to defy Premier Danielle Smith's government by establishing a safe haven for gender-affirming care. Chief Dale Steinhauer described the law as dehumanizing and says health care is protected under treaty rights.
title: Alberta First Nation wants to set up safe haven for gender-affirming care

description: Earth cooked to its hottest month on record in August, blowing far past a key climate threshold due to the dangerous double whammy of human-caused climate change and a supersized El Niño, according to the European climate service Copernicus.
title: August was Earth's hottest month, European climate agency finds

author: Alex Boyd
description: Debate about Alberta independence is dominated by a loose network of citizens, advocates and anonymous social media accounts. Some of whom are also selling home decor.
title: Separatists dominating Alberta referendum conversation online: report

description: Ontario Premier Doug Ford is set to speak to reporters around 12 p.m. Thursday following earlier remarks at the Toronto Region Board of Trade.
title: WATCH LIVE | Ontario Premier Doug Ford set to speak with reporters

description: Ontario Premier Doug Ford announced some changes to his cabinet Thursday, including moving embattled minister David Piccini from the labour portfolio to infrastructure.
title: Ontario premier announces cabinet shuffle, moves embattled labour minister to infrastructure profile

author: Jonathan Ore
description: The latest from Insomniac Games for the PlayStation 5 is a relentlessly paced action game that eschews an open world for constant forward momentum — and may initially shock players with its blood-soaked combat.
title: Marvel's Wolverine is a relentlessly bloody game with a sincere soap opera at its heart

author: Vincent McDermott
description: Many people in a community located more than 200 kilometres north of Fort McMurray have long believed there are links between cancers in their region and the industrial developments upstream along the Athabasca River.
title: Health study begins examining potential oilsands impacts on Alberta Indigenous community

author: Chris Iorfida
description: Donald Trump this week recounted an incident in the aftermath of the Sept. 11, 2001, attacks in downtown Manhattan that is long on descriptive detail but not easily verified.
title: Trump's 9/11 statements come under scrutiny again

description: At least 20 people have been killed in a fire aboard a foreign cargo vessel undergoing repairs at a ‌state-owned shipyard in the eastern Chinese city of Qingdao on Thursday, state media reported, with five others still missing.
title: At least 20 people dead in commercial ship fire in China

author: Janani Whitfield
description: The encampment in Pepsi Park has been steadily growing this summer, now reaching 70 tents and some 150 people. The city has moved to an outreach approach, rather than dismantling it. While some advocates call for more supports like showers and electricity, business owners say it's costing them.
title: Business owners say Regina's tent encampment is hurting neighbourhood

author: Emily Fagan
description: Saanich police watched but did not intervene for over a month as Canada's most prolific voyeur strode through businesses with a phone in hand while out on bail, in breach of bail conditions. Court records obtained by CBC News reveal that a Crown lawyer believed Yin Yeung Derek Chan was on the hunt for more victims in Fitness World and Value Village, where the voyeur had previously recorded hundreds of women and girls.
title: Police did not intervene as Canada's most prolific voyeur was 'looking for more victims,' court records show

author: Diego Pizarro
description: James Gordon, a resident of the Village of Riverside Glen retirement community in Guelph, Ont., jumped from a plane at an altitude of about 4,200 metres last month in his first skydiving adventure. 'I spun over, round and round, all over the place,' the spunky senior says.
title: 97-year-old Guelph, Ont., man skydives in quest to 'learn as much as I can about life'

author: Jennifer Sweet
description: Fishing associations are concerned that the independence and profitability of Atlantic inshore fishing are at risk because of where fishermen are getting the money they need to operate.
title: Soaring licence costs drive fishermen into questionable financing deals

description: President Donald Trump said on Wednesday he would pay every American adult a $5,000 US "Trump dividend" if Republicans retain control of Congress in November's midterm election, an extraordinary attempt to persuade voters to back his party.
title: Trump offers $5,000 US to every American if Republicans win midterm elections

author: Alex Kennedy
description: Twenty-five years after the Sept. 11 attacks on New York in 2001, the head of Newfoundland and Labrador's Muslim association says he looks back on the day with shock. However, Haseen Khan said communities rallied together in the years that followed to ensure support for Muslims in the province.
title: N.L. residents helped Muslims feel safe amid post-9/11 prejudice, says association leader

author: Jeff Lagerquist
description: According to a study by Toronto Metropolitan University, 98 per cent of financial sector workers are highly exposed to AI technologies. However, at least one Canadian bank expects its human headcount to rise.
title: Canadian bank CEOs can't stop bragging about AI. Will they kill jobs?

author: Justin Chandler
description: A Hamilton man has pleaded guilty to drugging and sexually assaulting two more women in a case that involved him recording and posting his actions online. Bryan Hayward, 37, pleaded guilty in June to seven counts. On Sept. 4, he pleaded guilty to charges involving two more women. He's also set for a Calgary trial in November.
title: Hamilton man who shared actions online pleads guilty to drugging, sexually assaulting 2 more women

author: Chris Brown
description: At Poland's massive MSPO arms fair, Canada arrives as the 'lead nation' with 230 firms. But shifting decades of reliance on the American market won't be easy.
title: No longer taboo, Canada's defence industry steps into Europe's spotlight

author: Eli Glasner
description: As the 51st edition of the Toronto International Film Festival rolls out the red carpet, the country's largest film festival is changing. With other festivals snagging buzzy world premieres, TIFF is reinventing itself as a place for making movie deals. But will this transformation combined with higher ticket prices hurt TIFF's tastemaker reputation?
title: TIFF's at a turning point — but how will the film festival's new focus on dealmaking affect fans?

author: Hénia Ould-Hammou
description: Louise De Sousa lost her daughter Anastasia in the Dawson College shooting in Montreal nearly 20 years ago. She reflects on the anniversary of her death, memories she has of her daughter and working through grief.
title: ‘Why did you go to school that day?’: Mother of Dawson shooting victim reflects 20 years later
